figures_added.what: Two cafe-table layouts (1 table = 4 seats, 2 tables = 6 seats) making the growing-by-2 sequence concrete before any algebra. Numbers match the opener boxes (6 and 8 seats) and the derived rule 2n+2.
Three matchstick square patterns in a row labelled 4, 7, 10, the classic GCSE pattern-sequence figure. Counts match the bronze teach walk: d=3, zero term 1, rule 3n+1, pattern 10 = 31.

notes: The Sequences bank is entirely numeric (each sequence is given as a list of numbers), so by the exam-realism test no bank problem prints a figure and none was added, matching the AQA sibling's judgement. Figures were added only where a real exam paper WOULD print one: the opener (growing cafe tables) and the bronze teach walk (matchstick pattern). Both SVGs are self-contained, theme-safe (currentColor strokes and text, soft region fills at 0.3 opacity so they read on light and dark), no external references, Inter labels, well under the size budget. Every visible number was cross-checked against its walk/opener numbers. Diagrams were done in the same pass as the guided conversion; the live row was PATCHed once with the combined practice_data.
